items.title: Lisa Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 22, 2021
items.q: my friend Cameron Undy the bass player here, we would practice scales together

ctx.x: This would be pure speculation, but if you grew up now, if you were starting now, where absolutely everything is available at the touch of a finger, I wonder if your playing would have turned out as original as it is?

It’s possible not, because what I am seeing from the times I’ve done some workshops like in Australia actually, and around the States, whenever I’ve gone to colleges or high schools or whatever and done workshops what I’m seeing is a lot of people shedding by themselves. And that is not cool. You’ve got to play with people. What — you know, practicing along with play-a-longs or just shedding by yourself you get used to not listening to somebody else. So for me, I always, I practice all the time with other people.…
